title: Quacky's Whacky Inven
description: Want a weird inventory UI? Just use this, you can customise each slot of your inventory to be wherever. Most likely allowed on PVP servers as its only a UI change :)
body:
# Quacky's Whacky Inven

Customize Minecraft inventory layout with drag-and-drop editing.

## Features

- **Custom Layout** - Drag slots anywhere, arrange inventory your way
- **Multiple Profiles** - Save different layouts for different playstyles
- **Profile Switching** - Quick swap with keybinds ([ and ])
- **Slot Categories** - Color-code by type (hotbar, armor, crafting, offhand)
- **Slot Numbers** - Display slot IDs, toggle in inventory
- **Layout Editor** - Multi-select with Ctrl+click, snap groups with S
- **Vanilla Actions** - Right-click, shift-click, double-click, middle-click all work
- **Keybinds** - 1-9 swap, F offhand, Q drop, I to open/close, configurable in Keybinds

## Controls

- **I** - Open/close custom inventory
- **[ / ]** - Previous/next profile
- **Left/Right arrows** - Switch profiles in inventory
- **C button** - Toggle slot colors
- **Unbound keybinds** - Set Cursor Start, Open Editor

## Settings

Configure in Mod Menu:
- Panel color & transparency
- Slot number display & alpha
- Grid snap
- Active profile

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.11+
- Fabric API
  
## Other Mods
Make sure to check out my organisation to find other mods! Helps a lot and lets me make more mods and maybe a common library in the future :)
